gosom-google-maps-scraper-google-maps-sc.description: Find businesses, leads, emails, reviews, ratings, and contact details from Google Maps. Use for requests such as "find cafés in Athens", "scrape Google Maps", "get local business leads", or "collect Google Maps reviews". Prefer the Google Maps Scraper MCP server when connected. Also supports local CLI runs with a native binary or Docker.
gosom-google-maps-scraper-google-maps-sc.author: gosom
